title: S7 latency-monitor — API surface
description: Port 7670, prefix LAT-. Endpoints (from router): GET /healthz, /readyz, /latency, /latency/{stage}, /percentiles, /budgets; POST /stamp. All latency math is integer nanoseconds (no floats).

stage.description: Canonical stage wire name (kebab-case). Aliases v2g/g2b/b2s/s2o/o2a are also accepted case-insensitively.

stageTimestampPairs.description: The (src, dst) timestamp field pair per stage; duration = dst - src. venue_to_gateway=(vt,rt), gateway_to_book=(rt,bt), book_to_signal=(bt,st), signal_to_order=(st,ot), order_to_ack=(ot,at). All int64 ns.

stampRequest.description: POST /stamp. A single latency observation. Two accepted forms: (1) pre-computed {stage, duration_ns, ...} — duration_ns must be >= 0; (2) a raw stage timestamp pair {stage, <src>, <dst>, ...} where src/dst come from the stage's pair (see stageTimestampPairs). Optional: symbol/sym, venue/ven, order_id/ord, id.

duration_ns.description: Pre-computed stage duration, int64 ns. Rejected if negative.

stageEnum.description: Canonical stage wire name (kebab-case); aliases v2g/g2b/b2s/s2o/o2a accepted case-insensitively by the service.
